reference_basis.documented: Numeric and group-qualified position register receive/send with selected value/comment options; SEND lists destination first
reference_basis.conflicts: Status tables label the result input; positional headings use RPREG while syntax/examples use RPOSREG

implementation_choices.signatures: Four operations, accepting both RPREG and RPOSREG position spellings; writable INTEGER status and ordinary internal-routine precedence
implementation_choices.banks: Explicit caller numeric register bank or context.positions plus selected PeerBanks service; never infer or substitute missing local/peer banks
implementation_choices.options: Numeric 0 value/comment, 1 value, 2 comment only; position 0 value/comment and 1 value; invalid option status 3
implementation_choices.copies: Preserve numeric INTEGER/REAL kind and exact POSITION/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS representation, configuration, external metadata and axis width; no robot conversion
implementation_choices.preflight: Snapshot selected source contents, validate both register addresses/groups and selected comment destination before publishing any transfer write; detach positional data
implementation_choices.comments: Independent comments, at most 16 characters and destination capacity; numeric comment-only requires no source value; value-only ignores comment storage
implementation_choices.status: Portable 0 success, 1 missing source value, 2 invalid address/group/comment address, 3 invalid option, 5 unbound peer; missing banks or malformed typed contents raise before writes
implementation_choices.guards: Arguments once in source order, exact writable status, read-only and transitive FOR protections; earlier completed argument effects retained
implementation_choices.persistence: Existing local and peers JSON bank schemas retain completed changes without task checkpoints, native layouts or network sessions

retained_boundaries: No networking, native RPC statuses/timing, robot compatibility, frame/tool conversion or implicit axis padding
No comment-only positional option, concurrent host-thread transaction or controller acceptance claim; strict remains future work
